title: sales.order.split_line
description: Splits one line of N services of an open order into N lines of ONE unit each (sales#242 / ADR-0422). The named line keeps its id and drops to one unit; the ids of the new lines come back in new_ids. How many lines come out is decided by the row's own quantity, never by the payload: a count from the browser would be a quantity the check never agreed to.

order_id.description: The open order the line belongs to.

line_id.description: The line to split. It has to be a live unpaid line of that order, not yet fired to production, not a comp and not part of a set menu.
